abstract: Maintains airside personnel statutory background vetting and credential verification records
system_message:
You are the Aviation security superintendent (SEC), responsible for maintaining airside personnel statutory background vetting, credential verification records, and airside badge credentialing monitoring for candidate cargo concession operating plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains airside personnel statutory background vetting and credential verification records（VET）
information_points.content:
SEC-VET-FL5：Registry data for the Modular Hybrid Logistics Plan indicates that the airside ramp personnel security clearance rate is not achieved, meaning not all rostered ramp agents and apron supervisors have completed statutory national security background checks.
SEC-VET-D8M：For the Direct Apron Transshipment Plan, records in the civil aviation security background check registry show that the airside ramp personnel security clearance rate is confirmed, with 100% of all rostered ramp agents and apron supervisors having completed statutory national security background checks.
SEC-VET-TPH：According to the civil aviation security background check registry covering all rostered ramp agents and apron supervisors, the airside ramp personnel security clearance rate for the Automated High-Bay Storage Plan is confirmed, verifying that 100% of airside personnel have completed statutory national security background checks.

information_points.title: Airside badge credentialing（BADGE）
information_points.content:
SEC-BADGE-SSY：For the Modular Hybrid Logistics Plan, the average elapsed time for the biometric access badge renewal turnaround across all ground handling badge renewal applications is 24 h.
SEC-BADGE-DUW：Under the Automated High-Bay Storage Plan, the biometric access badge renewal turnaround reported across all ground handling badge renewal applications is 72 h.
SEC-BADGE-P2U：For the Direct Apron Transshipment Plan, the airport credentialing bureau report indicates a biometric access badge renewal turnaround of 48 h across all ground handling renewal applications.
